node.statement: Using 1.6.3.2.1 and substituting the expression for m*beta from 1.6.3.2.2 gives m*(q - beta) = sum_j b_j*p_j - sum_k c_k*r_k - (sum_j b_j*beta_j - sum_k c_k*beta); distributing the minus sign and grouping the j- and k-sums yields m*(q - beta) = sum_j b_j*(p_j - beta_j) + sum_k c_k*(beta - r_k).
